newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - U.S.Robotics started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - U.S.Robotics started as buy.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns networking analyst Eric Blachno said he intiated coverage of U.S. Robotics Corp with a buy rating.
-- The analyst projected the leading modem maker and remote access equipment company would earn $2.37 per share for 1996 and $3.30 for 1997.
-- He said the company could earn $4.60 per share for 1998 but called that estimate "very preliminary."
-- He said the stock could reach $110 in the next 12 months, based on the multiple commanded by his preliminary 1998 estimate.
